Lossless existing-certificate value view. These are old claimed values, not newly verified matching/eligibility. a..b is inclusive consecutive ordered integers. U(Pn) is unique sorted original already-read trainer pool; E(Gn,Pm)=sorted intersection of G allowlist and U(Pm). E(...)-values removes literal listed indices. Direct W literals preserve original order, including unsorted arrays. W n is exact witness list length; original maximum_matching equals n, not proof of maximum. Every/some nodes are exactly identical. eligible_occurrences counts original candidate occurrences whose literal index is in G; eligible_template_indices is E. No game, eligibility predicate, random generator, or graph algorithm executes here.
PROFILES all_normal,standard,fancy,little_factory,little_direct,light_direct,strict_little,factory
Each file+P pool has one exact existing tuple for all its already-read trainer record occurrences; no record omitted. Eight columns follow PROFILES order. W prefix omitted in numeric tuple only.
